description: Finalize a direct upload once you have PUT the bytes to the uploadUrl from create_upload. Confirms the bytes landed and starts ingest: image/asset become ready immediately (status "complete"); audio/video enter processing (status "processing"). Returns { id, status, processingPhase }. 400 if no bytes were uploaded (PUT first) or the item is not yours. Then call wait_job(kind="media", id=mediaItemId), or use a media.completed webhook.

__schema0.description: Declared audio role: 'vo' (narration), 'music' (bed that ducks under speech), 'sfx' (one-shot hit), 'ambience' (a bed that HOLDS under VO — never ducks).

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: finalize_upload
title: Finalize Upload
